name: Detonator Box (Zip Cover)
description: A fabric Cover seals off part of the maze. One box elsewhere carries the zip slider — tapping it releases its marbles AND unzips the Cover in the same action. No counter, no waiting: you choose when.
howToPlay: Two purple/teal-framed boxes carry a zip slider. Tap one and watch its Cover unzip and sweep away, opening everything underneath at once. The catch: the trigger box sends its own marbles to the belt at the same moment — so the only question is when you spend it. Pair 1 (purple) opens the 2x3 block up top; pair 2 (teal) opens the L wrapping the right side.
author: Prototype
